preview_heading: Qualifier 2: the last chance to reach the CPL 2026 final
preview: The Eliminator winner faces the losing team from Qualifier 1 in CPL 2026 Qualifier 2 at Kensington Oval on September 18. Play starts at 7:00pm Barbados time. The winner secures the remaining place in the final, while the losing team is eliminated.
preview_detail: One participant will be the winner of the Barbados Tridents vs Jamaica Kingsmen Eliminator. The other will be the losing team from the Antigua & Barbuda Falcons vs Guyana Amazon Warriors Qualifier 1. Team names will be updated after both results are confirmed, with the toss result and confirmed playing XIs added when announced on match day.
